entries.clue: Where to find an aglet, given few resources? (2,1,10)

blocks.note: an aglet is the plastic tip at the end of a lace, so the question is where it sits

annotation.surface: A puzzled question about where a lace tip lives, asked of someone scraping by.
annotation.walkthrough: An aglet is an obscure word most solvers must look up; once known, the literal reading of the idiom falls out.
annotation.definitionFit: Idiom: doing something on a shoestring means doing it with very little money, and the aglet reading takes the phrase literally.

kept as written
kept as written

annotation.walkthrough: "Five parts in" reads as the report's structure; really V and IN are the parts that join REPORT in the mix.
annotation.definitionFit: Definition by description: printing extra matter over a sheet already printed, so adding to a document.
